contentEn:
Cabinet refacing in Vancouver means replacing cabinet doors and drawer fronts while keeping your existing cabinet boxes. It costs $4,000 to over $50,000 depending on the option you choose — dramatically less than full custom replacement and faster too.

Reno Stars has completed dozens of cabinet refacing projects across Richmond, Surrey, Burnaby, West Vancouver, and Langley in 2025 and 2026. Here is what Vancouver homeowners actually paid, based on real project data.

What Cabinet Refacing Actually Means in Vancouver

True cabinet refacing involves three approaches in Vancouver's renovation market:

  • Refinishing: Sand and spray-paint or spray-laminate the existing doors and drawer fronts. Cost: $4,000–$8,000. Best for: tight budgets, rental properties, or a quick refresh. The finish is less durable than new doors.
  • Refacing: Remove the old doors and drawer fronts entirely and hang new pre-made or custom doors and drawer fronts on the existing cabinet boxes. New hinges and hardware throughout. Cost: $8,000–$18,000. Best for: most homeowners who want a completely new look with solid durability.
  • Full Custom Replacement: Remove everything including the cabinet boxes. New custom or modular cabinets are built and installed. Cost: $20,000–$50,000+. Best for: layout changes, severely damaged boxes, or premium finishes.

The refinishing vs refacing distinction matters. When Vancouver homeowners say refacing they often mean door-and-drawer-front replacement. Reno Stars quotes both separately so you know exactly what you are paying for.

These are project-budget figures from real Reno Stars jobs in Vancouver, Surrey, Richmond, and Burnaby. Actual cost depends on kitchen size, material selection, and whether electrical or plumbing coordination is required.

How Reno Stars Approaches Cabinet Refacing in Vancouver

Every cabinet refacing project in Vancouver follows the same four-step process:

  1. Initial consultation: Share your goals, preferred style, and budget. Reno Stars visits your home or reviews photos and measurements.
  2. Material and hardware selection: Choose door style (Shaker, slab, raised-panel), material (MDF, plywood, solid wood), finish (painted, natural wood veneer, laminate), and hardware (knobs, pulls, hinges).
  3. Measurement and order: Reno Stars measures every cabinet opening precisely. Doors and drawer fronts are ordered to exact dimensions.
  4. Installation and final walkthrough: Old doors and drawer fronts are removed. New ones are hung. Hardware is installed. Final inspection confirms everything matches your vision.

Most Vancouver cabinet refacing jobs complete in two to four weeks from first consultation to final walkthrough.

When to Reface vs Replace Your Cabinets in Vancouver

Vancouver homeowners should replace rather than reface in these situations:

  • The cabinet boxes are water-damaged, warped, or rotting
  • You want to change the kitchen layout — moving sinks, cooktops, or adding islands
  • The existing cabinets have Particleboard boxes that are swollen or delaminating
  • You are doing a full gut renovation and want maximum design flexibility

In all other cases — boxes structurally sound, layout unchanged — cabinet refacing delivers a brand-new look at a fraction of the cost and time. Reno Stars assesses every kitchen in person before quoting so you know whether refacing or replacement is genuinely the right call.

Cabinet Refacing in Vancouver: 2026 Cost Factors That Affect Your Quote

  • Cabinet material: MDF doors are the most affordable; solid wood and plywood-panel doors cost more and last longer
  • Finish type: Thermofoil or laminate is budget-friendly; painted finishes and natural wood veneers cost more
  • Kitchen size: A typical 10-foot-wide kitchen requires fewer doors than a 16-foot kitchen with a pantry tower
  • Hardware: Basic knobs are inexpensive; premium pulls, soft-close hinges, and integrated LED diffusers add cost
  • Electrical or plumbing changes: Moving outlets, adding under-cabinet lighting, or rerouting plumbing increase the total

FAQ: Cabinet Refacing in Vancouver

How much does cabinet refacing cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Cabinet refinishing in Vancouver starts around $4,000. Full cabinet refacing with new doors and drawer fronts typically costs $8,000–$18,000 for a standard kitchen. Full custom cabinet replacement runs $20,000–$50,000+. All figures are from real Reno Stars project budgets in Greater Vancouver.

How long does cabinet refacing take in Vancouver?

Most cabinet refacing projects in Vancouver take two to four weeks from initial consultation to final walkthrough. Custom-ordered doors may add one to two weeks to the timeline. Reno Stars manages the entire process including material coordination.

Does cabinet refacing add value to a Vancouver home?

Yes. Updated kitchens consistently rank among the highest-ROI improvements in Vancouver real estate. Cabinet refacing delivers a new-kitchen look at a fraction of replacement cost, making it one of the most cost-effective renovations for resale preparation.

What is the difference between cabinet refinishing and cabinet refacing?

Refinishing paints or laminates your existing doors. Refacing removes the old doors and installs new pre-made or custom doors and drawer fronts on the existing cabinet boxes. Refacing gives a more durable and complete new look than refinishing.

Does Vancouver require a permit for cabinet refacing?

In most cases, no. Cabinet refacing — replacing doors, drawer fronts, and hardware on existing cabinet boxes — does not typically require a Vancouver building permit. A permit is required if you are moving plumbing, changing cabinet layout, or doing structural work. Reno Stars confirms permit requirements during the initial consultation.

温哥华的橱柜翻新是指在保留原有柜体框架的基础上更换门板和抽屉面板。根据选择的方案不同，费用为 $4,000 至 $50,000 以上 — 大大低于全屋定制，且工期更短。

Reno Stars 在 2025 和 2026 年已在列治文、素里、本拿比、西温哥华和兰里完成了数十个橱柜翻新项目。以下是大温哥华地区业主的实际花费数据。

温哥华橱柜翻新的三种方案

温哥华橱柜翻新市场主要有三种方案：

  • 翻新烤漆：对现有门板和抽屉面板进行打磨、喷漆或覆膜。费用：$4,000–$8,000。适合：预算有限、出租房或快速翻新。耐久性相对较低。
  • 橱柜翻新：拆除旧门板和抽屉面板，在原有柜体框架上安装全新的门板和抽屉面板，更换所有铰链和五金件。费用：$8,000–$18,000。适合：大多数希望彻底改变外观的业主。
  • 全屋定制更换：拆除所有柜体，包括框架，全新定制或模块化橱柜。费用：$20,000–$50,000+。适合：需要改变布局、框架损坏或追求高端装修的业主。

翻新烤漆与橱柜翻新的区别很重要。当温哥华业主说refacing时，通常指的是门板和抽屉面板更换。Reno Stars 会分别报价，让客户清楚了解每种方案的具体内容。

以下数据均来自 Reno Stars 在大温哥华地区的真实项目预算。

方案费用范围适合情况

橱柜翻新（新门板+抽屉面板）$8,000–$18,000大多数业主，性价比与耐久性兼备
全屋定制更换$20,000–$50,000+改变布局、框架损坏、高端定制

以上为 Reno Stars 在温哥华、素里、列治文和本拿比的真实项目数据，非估算价格。

Reno Stars 的橱柜翻新流程

每个橱柜翻新项目均遵循相同的四步流程：

  1. 初步咨询：了解您的目标、风格偏好和预算。Reno Stars 上门或通过照片和尺寸进行评估。
  2. 选材和五金选择：选择门板风格（Shaker，光板、立体雕花）、材质（MDF、胶合板、实木）、饰面（烤漆、木皮、层压板）和五金件。
  3. 精确测量并下单：对每个橱柜开口进行精确测量，向厂家定制门板和抽屉面板。
  4. 安装和最终验收：拆除旧门板，安装新面板，安装五金件，最终陪同业主验收。

大多数温哥华橱柜翻新项目从首次咨询到最终验收需两到四周。

何时选择翻新而非更换

以下情况应选择全屋更换而非翻新：柜体框架泡水损坏、需改变厨房布局、原有柜体为刨花板且已膨胀脱层、正在进行全面拆改并希望最大程度灵活设计。在其他情况下，橱柜翻新都能以较低的成本和时间实现全新外观。

常见问题

2026年温哥华橱柜翻新多少钱？

温哥华橱柜翻新烤漆起步价约 $4,000。全屋橱柜翻新（新门板和抽屉面板）标准厨房通常为 $8,000–$18,000。全屋定制更换为 $20,000–$50,000+。以上均为 Reno Stars 在大温哥华地区的真实项目预算。

温哥华橱柜翻新需要多长时间？

大多数温哥华橱柜翻新项目从首次咨询到最终验收需两到四周。定制门板可能额外增加一至两周。Reno Stars 全程管理材料协调和施工进度。

橱柜翻新能增加温哥华房产价值吗？

是的。翻新厨房一直是温哥华房地产中投资回报最高的装修项目之一。橱柜翻新以较低成本实现全新厨房外观，是出售前装修中最具成本效益的选择。

橱柜翻新和全屋更换有何区别？

翻新烤漆是对现有门板进行喷漆或覆膜。橱柜翻新是拆除旧门板，在原有柜体框架上安装全新的门板和抽屉面板。橱柜翻新比翻新烤漆更耐用、外观更完整。

温哥华橱柜翻新需要申请许可证吗？

大多数情况下不需要。更换门板、抽屉面板和五金件通常不需要温哥华建筑许可证。但如果涉及移动管道、改变橱柜布局或进行结构工程，则需要许可证。Reno Stars 在首次咨询时确认许可要求。
